region: Platform default (NSW and QLD), used only until an LGA's own rules are loaded
stamp: PLATFORM DEFAULT, LGA RULE NOT LOADED
note: Every row is status platform_default and carries the stamp. No other key has a default: those resolve UNRESOLVED. Drainage conventions from outside the LGA's own rules are not used (owner decision D5). The stamp on a result states why the default applies: LGA RULE NOT LOADED, LGA VALUE NOT FOUND or LGA VALUE UNRESOLVED.
